axis: self-esteem swollen past reason → that swollen self-esteem turned outward as a superior manner toward those below

members.tone: Here the word is a vice and not a virtue - self-esteem grown unreasonable and past all proportion, and grave enough to stand as one of the deadly sins.
A flat accusation: the swollen self-regard of *pride* has stopped being inward and is now overbearing, worn as a superior manner toward those it counts as inferior.
Formal and chilly, naming the same overbearing pride as a bearing one carries above inferiors rather than levelling the blunt charge *arrogance* makes.
